nodes.label: Web Dojo WYSIWYG Builder
nodes.rationale: A WYSIWYG website builder (React + Tailwind + shadcn/ui frontend, FastAPI + Motor + MongoDB backend) supporting drag-and-drop and code editing, HTML import with section-scanning, a Photoshop-style color/gradient editor, standalone HTML and HTML+CSS zip export; no auth by design (single-user, local-first).

nodes.label: Encrypted Publish Presets
nodes.rationale: Encrypted (Fernet) FTP/FTPS/SFTP profile storage; only ciphertext (password_enc) is ever persisted, API responses expose only has_password. The /secret endpoint deliberately returns plaintext with no per-endpoint auth, consistent with the single-user no-auth trust model, closed against browser-based exfiltration by the CORS fix rather than by adding auth.

nodes.label: Starter Aesthetic Gallery
nodes.rationale: 28 curated single-page starter templates seeded on backend startup with fixed IDs (idempotent upsert), each with a matched aesthetic slug/palette/fonts; not deletable by users (DELETE returns 403).

nodes.label: Form Submissions Inbox
nodes.rationale: Forms built in Web Dojo POST to /api/submissions so deployed/previewed sites capture real entries; buildFormHtml injects hidden metadata inputs and an inline script that intercepts submit and POSTs FormData via fetch. Later scoped per-project by the round-2 audit fix after being found unscoped.

nodes.label: Stripe + PayPal Commerce Integration
nodes.rationale: Stripe (real Payment Links/Checkout Sessions) and PayPal (client-side Smart Buttons SDK) checkout for exported static sites; commerce.js's build-time HTML emitters were found to interpolate free-text fields unescaped, unlike cart.js's own runtime esc() — an inconsistency fixed by the shared escapeHtml utility.

nodes.label: Background Music Feature
nodes.rationale: Page-level background music: MP3 renders a floating play/pause pill widget, MIDI loads html-midi-player via CDN; buildMusicHtml's url/accent/label were found unescaped and fixed to use escAttr/escText.

nodes.label: Social Buttons Tool
nodes.rationale: 'Share this page' (built-in platform templates, already safe) and 'Link to profiles' (18 platforms) modes; the follow-mode href, built from a user-entered profile URL, was found unescaped and fixed with escAttr.
